desc:
🕺 Dance Among the Clones

The Hunter is coming. Don’t let them know which one is you.

🤫 Blend in with a crowd of your own clones!
🎵 Keep dancing to avoid suspicion!
🎭 Deploy decoys that look exactly like you and trick the Hunter!
👀 Stop at the wrong time and you might get spotted!
😵 Place down decoys around the map, dance among them, and make the Hunter guess!
🏆 Outlast everyone else and be the last one standing!

👍 Like & Favorite for more updates!
